_comment: C0-13 jimeng bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（doubao-chat/tongyi-wanxiang），related 写 2 条（frontmatter related 有 3 项含 kling，但 related 键按正文链接行对齐=2）。sources 3 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: The image line's workhorse is ByteDance's Seedream series (in-site version narrative shows tiers like "Image 4.0"), the video line is the Seedance series — Jimeng is the consumer-facing product entry for these two model families. Models are listed by ByteDance; users pick tiers, not bare models; the concrete current list follows the logged-in interface.
axes.runtime: Web (jimeng.jianying.com) + iOS/Android apps; generation is processed on ByteDance's cloud, no models run locally. Deep integration with the CapCut ecosystem (one-click sharing to Douyin etc.) is part of the official narrative.
axes.local_files: Generated works and uploaded materials are stored account-side in the cloud; downloads go local. No officially stated local data surface.
axes.background: Generation tasks queue and run in the cloud (the credit system and an "acceleration" lane are product semantics); tasks continue after you leave the page — the cloud-queue form differs from the "instant return" of general chat products.
axes.tools: Capability lines inside the product: text-to-image, image editing (local erasure/repaint), smart canvas, text-to-video/image-to-video, video lip-sync/frame interpolation etc. (as seen on the official site and app notes); the community "make the same style" feature is its distribution surface.
axes.context: Organized by works/sessions; cross-session memory mechanism — no official statement verified (unknown means unknown).
axes.permissions: Account system (Douyin login is primary); three ways to get credits — daily free grant + top-up + membership (D9: price figures not collected); membership tiers include a "remove brand watermark" benefit — watermark rules vary by tier, check the in-site notes before use.
axes.fit: Fits: Chinese-prompt image generation, image+video one-stop, Douyin-ecosystem publishing chain. Does not fit: wanting model self-selection; wanting watermark-free free output (watermark is tied to tier); wanting models running locally.

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creative products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **The actual daily allowance and expiry rules of free credits** (D9: prices not collected; allowance behavior needs measurement)
- **Whether the Image 4.0 tier is still free-for-a-limited-time now** (in-site promos are time-limited)
- **Where the generative-AI service filing is disclosed** (whether the site discloses the filing no. of the models it uses)
unknowns:
- The generative-AI service filing number (not verified on official disclosure pages)
- The complete current model-tier list (follows the logged-in interface)
- Cross-session memory mechanism (no official statement verified)
- The training-use switch path and default state (not verified line by line)
related: Same vendor, different entries: Doubao is text-to-image inside a chat, Jimeng is a dedicated creation bench.
Both domestic image+video one-stop creation benches: Wanxiang has an open-weights line, Jimeng does not.
